name: NoAtmoFX
author: Paulleonard (scarface)
description: This mod will completely remake the Nuclear Option atmosphere, including clouds of all types, from fair-weather cumulus to full overcast and towering thunderstorms. Everything follows the mission weather and changes slowly as you fly, with fronts, rain, lightning, cloud shadows, light shafts and a wet canopy. Even nuclear blasts tear a hole through the clouds and leave condensation rings around the mushroom cloud. Install the whole zip (DLL and the noatmofx bundle).
